action_items: Seed facts in briefing/test_credentials.md are stale: the live DB currently has only 2 employees (both admin: 'Henrique J', 'Paulo H') and PINs 0000/1111/2222/3333 (caixa/garcom/cozinha) do NOT exist. Only PIN 1234 (admin) works. Worked around by using admin for all role checks (admin passes every require() check) and by creating one tscheck- caixa employee for the 403 negative test. This is a data-state note, not an app bug.

The 'Cash session is open' seed fact was also false at test time (cash was closed, returned null from GET /api/cash/current). Opened a real cash session via POST /api/cash/open (additive, non-destructive) so PDV/invoice flows could be exercised, since an open cash session is required baseline app state, not seeded test data.

checks.criterion: PDV cart lines use stable keys (code-review fix)
checks.name: pdv-cart-stable-keys-checkout
checks.evidence: Logged in as admin (1234), added 3 distinct products to /pdv cart, set note 'sem cebola' on 2nd line, removed 1st line via cart-dec-0 (qty 1 -> removed), confirmed note stayed on the product by checking cart-notes-0 == 'sem cebola' after removal (count 3->2). Checked out via PIX, payment-dialog confirmed, saw 'finalizada' success toast.

checks.name: mesas-pending-stable-keys
checks.evidence: Opened free Mesa 7 via table-card-7 -> open-table-button, added 2 products to pending (auto-opens add grid), set note 'sem cebola' on pending-line-1, decremented pending-line-0's qty (1->0, removed), verified pending-notes-0 == 'sem cebola' (now 1st line). Sent items: POST .../tables/{id}/items returned <400 (captured via waitForResponse) and 'Itens enviados' toast appeared. (First attempt failed intermittently waiting for add-items-button right after opening the table because opening already auto-sets adding=true, racing with the button's brief visibility; rewritten to wait on table-order-items instead -> passed on rerun.)

checks.criterion: Public QR menu cart stable keys
checks.name: cardapio-public-cart-stable-keys
checks.evidence: Opened /cardapio/<free table id> (no login, public route), added 2 distinct products via public-add-*, opened public-cart-sheet (2 lines), captured 2nd line's product name, removed 1st line via public-cart-dec-0 (qty1->removed), verified remaining line (public-cart-line-0) now shows the product/name that was previously on line 1, and public-send-order button still enabled.

checks.evidence: First run hit transient infra-level 429s (rate limiting on the preview ingress from rapid successive checks) causing body to be hidden/blocked; rerun ~20s later passed cleanly: Dashboard (/), /vendas, /caixa, /cozinha loaded with no console errors and no API responses >=400; /config?tab=backup showed the Drive panel text 'Aguardando as credenciais...'
